# OpenElement

> OpenElement is an open-source compiled-element web framework: author
> components with JSX-like element syntax, compile them into custom elements
> with server-side rendering and islands hydration, and ship them through the
> framework's own router and docs site engine. The workspace ships the
> `@openelement/*` packages, the `openelement` CLI, and this site.

## Start here

- [Home](https://openelement.org/): the framework overview and the published version line.
- [Getting started](https://openelement.org/guide/getting-started): install and scaffold a first project.
- [Core concepts](https://openelement.org/guide/core-concepts): elements, blocks, islands, and the compiled-element model.
- [Tutorial](https://openelement.org/guide/tutorial): a full walk through authoring, routing, and deployment.

## Reference

- [API reference](https://openelement.org/reference): the public exports, generated from the real package surface.
- [Error codes](https://openelement.org/errors): every `OEC####` / `OE_*` diagnostic code with its message, generated from the code registries.
- [Error handling](https://openelement.org/guide/error-handling): the machine-readable diagnostics envelope (`openelement.diagnostics/1`).

## For coding agents

- [Agent development contract](https://github.com/open-element/openelement/blob/main/docs/maintainers/agent-contract.md): the standard contract — canonical commands (derived from package.json), the generated-file map (never hand-edit), gate semantics, diagnostics consumption, and the ritual checklist. Mechanically enforced by a conformance test.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/open-element/openelement/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the repository's contribution doctrine — the vp task entry, the gate architecture, and the release path.
- [Build diagnostics](https://github.com/open-element/openelement/blob/main/packages/protocol/src/diagnostics.ts): the envelope types — parse build failures with `parseDiagnosticReport` from `@openelement/protocol/diagnostics`, never by grepping logs.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/open-element/openelement/blob/main/docs/architecture/): design principles, package boundaries, and the seam registry.
